parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid of the kitchen pot is made of stainless steel, circular in shape, and fits snugly on top of the pot.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the pot to retain heat and moisture during cooking, preventing spills and speeding up the cooking process.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or placed on the pot but does not move independently during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body of the kitchen pot is a cylindrical container made of stainless steel with a handle for gripping.
parts.Functional_description: It holds food and liquids for cooking, providing even heat distribution across its surface.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during cooking but can be lifted or moved by the handle when needed.
